content: We observed similar results on other ShapeWorldICE datasets that we experimented with, validating the superiority of LRCN1u over Show&Tell on ShapeWorldICE. Consequently, we decided to focus on the LRCN1u architecture in subsequent evaluations, where we report detailed results with respect to the GTD framework on a variety of datasets.
